01 — About the club

Not just fashion.
A full production house run by students.

REVA University runs a thriving club culture, with hundreds of students active across its student clubs — and the Fashion Club is where the campus's most creative energy converges. We design collections, cast and train models, style editorials, shoot campaigns and produce full-scale runway shows at Rukmini Knowledge Park.

“Style is a language. On this campus, we speak it fluently — in fabric, light and movement.”

Open to every school

Engineers, designers, architects, management and arts students — if you love fashion, you belong here.

Learn by producing

No spectators. Every member works on real shows, shoots and campaigns each semester.

Heritage × street

From handloom-inspired drapes to Bengaluru streetwear — we celebrate Indian craft with a modern eye.

Sustainable first

Upcycled denim lines, thrift swaps and fabric-waste audits are built into how we create.

Next — The Endless Thread ↓

The star of the show

One thread. No beginning, no end.

Look at REVA's emblem — an endless knot, one line that weaves over and under itself forever. That is also how a garment is born: one thread, looped through a needle, stitching separate pieces into something whole. So this site is stitched, not stacked — the orange thread runs down the edge of your screen as you scroll, loops through the hero, and sews every show together below. Where the thread goes, the story goes.

The knot = REVAThe thread = the craftThe diamond = every stitch

04 — On the calendar

Shows, workshops
& style weeks

The club's year moves in rhythms — one flagship spectacle, and a steady pulse of smaller stages to learn on.

FlagshipAnnual

REVOUGE — The Annual Fashion Show

Our biggest night of the year: full collections from the design vertical, a full cast of student models, live choreography and a front row of faculty, alumni and Bengaluru's fashion community.

WorkshopsMonthly

Atelier Saturdays

Hands-on skill labs — draping on the stand, thrift-flip upcycling, makeup for stage lights, and phone-to-DSLR photography drills, led by senior members and guest stylists.

EditorialEach semester

Campus Editorial Shoots

Themed photo stories shot across Rukmini Knowledge Park — heritage architecture, monsoon light, festival colour — published as the club's digital lookbook.

SustainabilityEach semester

The Great REVA Thrift Swap

A campus-wide clothing exchange and repair café. Bring a garment, take a garment, learn to mend — fashion that loves the planet back.

Next — How a show is born ↓

05 — How a show is born

From moodboard
to spotlight

Watch the thread fill as the show comes together

The lineup after the finale — where a semester of work becomes ten minutes of magic.

  1. Concept & moodboard

    Each season starts with a theme — a colour story, a craft tradition, a feeling. The whole club builds the world together.

  2. Design & draping

    Designers sketch, drape and prototype. Fittings begin, fabrics are sourced, and every look gets a name and a story.

  3. Casting & rehearsals

    Open auditions, walk training and choreography blocks. Models, stylists and the MUA team lock their sequences.

  4. Backstage choreography

    Quick-change maps, call sheets, lighting and music cues — rehearsed until the chaos backstage runs like clockwork.

  5. Show night

    Lights down. Music up. Ten minutes that the whole campus talks about for a semester — then we start again.

06 — The core team

Led by students,
elected every year

The club is run by a core team chosen from its own members each academic year, with a faculty coordinator from REVA University mentoring the crew.

President

Sets the season's vision, leads the core team and represents the club across the university.

Creative Director

Owns the theme, the looks and the story of every show and editorial the club produces.

Head of Design

Leads the couture vertical — patterns, fittings, fabric budgets and the atelier calendar.

Runway Lead

Casts models, runs walk training and choreographs every formation on the ramp.

Media & Photography Lead

Directs the lens team — editorials, show coverage, reels and the club's visual archive.

Events & Sponsorship Lead

Produces show nights end-to-end — venues, partners, budgets, and the front-of-house experience.

07 — Join the club

Your walk starts
with one audition.

Auditions open at the start of every semester and are open to students of every school at REVA University. No experience needed for most verticals — bring curiosity, commitment and one idea you're proud of.

  1. 1Fill the interest form — it takes two minutes.
  2. 2Download your application summary and keep it handy.
  3. 3Watch the club notice boards & student groups for audition dates, and show up ready to create.
Next — Before you audition ↓

Good questions

Before you audition

I'm an engineering student. Can I still join?

Absolutely — most of our members are. The club is open to every school at REVA University, and some of our best stylists and photographers started in engineering classrooms.

I've never modelled or designed before. Is that okay?

Yes. Modelling, styling, makeup and production verticals train you from zero. For design, basic sketching helps but the atelier workshops will teach you draping and stitching step by step.

How much time does the club take each week?

Typically 2–3 hours a week for workshops and vertical meets, rising in the two weeks before a show. Show weeks are intense — and unforgettable.

Do I need my own camera, makeup kit or sewing machine?

No. The club shares equipment across verticals, and shoots are planned around what the team has. Bring what you own; borrow the rest.

When do auditions happen?

At the start of every semester. Fill the interest form above and keep an eye on university notice boards and student club announcements for the exact dates.

Your portal account

How do I get a login ID?

Only the Admin or a club official can create your account. Ask the Admin or the President — there is no self sign-up. Once your account is created, you will receive your login ID and a temporary password.

I forgot my password — what do I do?

Your temporary password on your first sign-in is your mobile number. After signing in, change it from Settings inside the portal. If you are locked out, ask the Admin to reset it for you.

Who can see my email and phone number?

Only the President, the Vice Presidents and the Admin. Other officials and members cannot see your contact details.

Can I sign up by myself?

No — there is no public sign-up. Accounts are created by the Admin or by club officials only.

Next — Privacy policy ↓

The small print

Privacy policy

The REVA Fashion Club portal collects only what a member account needs: your name, login ID, email address and mobile number. This information is collected when the Admin or a club official creates your account — there is no public sign-up form.

Your email address and mobile number are visible only to the President, the Vice Presidents and the Admin. Other officials and members cannot see your contact details. Your own record is always visible to you.

We use your details only to run the club — show calls, announcements, and messages between members and officials. We do not share member details outside the club, and we do not sell them or use them for advertising.

Photos and videos from club shows, shoots and events may appear in the lookbook on this website and in club announcements. If you would like a photo of you taken down, message the Admin through the portal and it will be removed.

If you leave the club, ask the Admin to remove your account, and your contact details will be removed with it.

Next — Terms of service ↓

The small print

Terms of service

The REVA Fashion Club website and portal are run by the club for its members, officials and the Admin. By using the portal you agree to use it only for club activities — shows, rehearsals, announcements and messages between members.

Accounts are created by the Admin or by club officials only, and there is no public sign-up. Your login ID and password are yours alone — do not share them, and change your temporary password (your mobile number) after your first sign-in.

Only the Admin can assign club roles such as President and Vice President. Officials may create member accounts, but cannot hand out offices. The Admin may remove accounts that break club rules or are no longer active.

Photos and videos taken at club shows and events may be published in the lookbook and in club announcements. Be kind in messages and announcements — anything harassing, hateful or unrelated to the club may be removed, and the account behind it may lose access.

These terms may be updated as the club grows; the latest version is always the one on this page.
